lines.zh: 小爪子扒着地，嘶嘶作响。
lines.en: Small claws scraping dirt, I hiss.

lines.zh: 我穿过蕨丛，故意压出声响。
lines.en: I push through the ferns, loud on purpose.

lines.zh: 小爪子扒着石头往前挪。
lines.en: My little claws haul me forward over the rocks.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在地上，扫出一道痕。
lines.en: My tail drags a line across the ground.

lines.zh: 我贴着暖和的岩面爬行。
lines.en: I crawl along the warm rock face.

lines.zh: 天冷的时候，我动得很慢。
lines.en: When it is cold, I barely move.
When it's cold, I just want to sleep.

lines.zh: 晒热的石头正合我的背。
lines.en: A sun-warmed rock fits my back.

lines.zh: 暖石头上趴着，我不想动。
lines.en: Sprawled on a warm rock, I don't want to move.

lines.zh: 我趴在暖石头上，懒得动。
lines.en: On a warm stone I cannot be bothered.
I'm flipping a rotten log for grubs.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只舌头在动。
lines.en: I stay still—only my tongue stirs.

lines.zh: 我趴在石头上晒太阳取暖。
lines.en: I sprawl on a stone to soak up the warmth.

lines.zh: 尾巴先扫一圈，试试深浅。
lines.en: My tail sweeps once to test you.
My little tail has no strength yet.
I reached this grove before you did.
My teeth aren't all in. Don't worry.

lines.zh: 等我长大，咬一口你就掉血上限。
lines.en: Wait till I grow — one bite lowers your max health.
A scale got flipped off my flank.
Hiss, my little claws hurt so much!
I am this small, and you hit me!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，这东西看起来不错！

lines.en: That chunk of meat still smells of blood.
I lick my lips and creep forward.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖扫在你脚踝上。
lines.en: My tail tip swipes across your ankle.
My tail swings faster than my teeth.
My fangs are shorter than my milk teeth.
If you crash into me, you won't back off whole.

lines.zh: 小古巨蜥，爪已经伸出来。
lines.en: A young Megalania's claws are out.
Small as I am, I will still fight you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经刮到你了。

lines.en: Even a small megalania bites. Do not touch.
My venom fang scraped your leg.
My tail coils around your leg.

lines.zh: 我们挖同一个洞住下吧。
lines.en: Let's dig one burrow and share it.

lines.zh: 别走，我的巢就在石堆后。
lines.en: Don't go—my nest is right behind those rocks.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拍着地面，等你。
lines.en: My tail slaps the ground, waiting for you.
My fangs aren't full yet. Enough.
I pick up a bone and keep my eyes on you.
Claws hold you. Now a bite.

lines.zh: 我虽小，毒牙已经长齐了。
lines.en: Small, but my venom fangs are in.
I caught the mud on your boots.

lines.zh: 你的影子先动了，我跟着。
lines.en: Your shadow moved first; I follow it.

lines.zh: 草丛里有热乎乎的味道。
lines.en: Something warm-smelling is in the grass.
You moved, and I saw it.
A shadow passes and I lift my head.
Your scent drifts over from your feet.
I am small, but my teeth will do.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，听你的脚步。
lines.en: I hug the ground and listen to your steps.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尾巴绷直了。
lines.en: I flatten down, my tail pulled straight.

lines.zh: 爪尖在石面上刮出细响。
lines.en: My claws scrape softly on the stone.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚踝，那里最软。
lines.en: I watch your ankle; it is the softest part.

lines.zh: 我的毒牙已经开始发痒。
lines.en: My venom fangs are itching already.
I will circle around to your side first.

lines.zh: 我伏在落叶里，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I crouch in the leaf litter with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的嘶声越来越低。
lines.en: The hiss in my throat sinks lower.
I wait for you to turn away.

lines.zh: 你背对我的时候最好下手。
lines.en: Your back is the easiest side to take.
My tail is already coiled behind me.
In the heat I am quick to strike.
You can't run, I got you!
Venom seeps in along the tooth marks.
My fangs sink in and your blood slows.
My tail sweeps your legs out!

lines.zh: 爪子扒住你的裤腿往上爬！
lines.en: My claws climb your trouser leg!

lines.zh: 我扑上去，挂在你的手臂！
lines.en: I leap and hang from your arm!
Hiss. Once I bite, I do not let go!
I butt my head into your knee!

lines.zh: 我翻滚着缠上你的靴子！
lines.en: I roll and coil around your boot!

lines.zh: 我的咬伤很久都不会好！
lines.en: The wound I leave will not close!
Small as I am, my bite holds tight!
I break out of the eggshell.

lines.zh: 培育器里的黏液还在滴。
lines.en: Slime still drips off me from the incubator.

lines.zh: 我在石堆下第一次抬头。
lines.en: Beneath the rubble I raise my head for the first time.

lines.zh: 冷地方出生的我颜色更深。
lines.en: Born in the cold, my hide came out darker.
